steps: A locally overridden instance opens its raw shared declaration, not its effective or local values. No field is implicitly selected and cancel preserves all author bytes.

Three explicitly selected fields create one exact shared actor patch. Both placements inherit size, while an existing local position and color stay authoritative. Complete source and per-instance impact review survives three 390px locales; apply only edits memory.
Normal Save changes only the original recipe, and reopening preserves all stable instances, groups, placements, local overrides, metadata and asset bytes.

An absent optional image field stays unselected and empty until explicitly set to a registered resource; full dependency/image review reaches both associated instances and ordinary Save preserves other declarations.
A field changed without an input event cannot reuse review approval. Cancel leaves the saved declaration untouched.
An external source write after shared review is protected by normal Save conflict handling, preserving both external bytes and the local shared draft without forced overwrite.
limitations: Real HTTP editor and Chrome only; no installed Tauri window or Android device acceptance.
Six explicit set-only shared actor fields in one recipe source session. No declaration deletion, placement-offset change, executable recipe build or cross-file transaction.
confirmations: 丢弃本次共享片段修改？原文草稿不会改变。
